hypotheses.name: Multiseed sparse-descriptor consensus robustness
hypotheses.method: Across immune/lung/external_lung with seeds 42/43/44, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}, reran H87-style sparse descriptor blend over H70 baseline, evaluated descriptor-shuffle/endpoint-swap/label-permutation nulls, and measured cross-seed descriptor-core stability (nonzero-set Jaccard/sign agreement).
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.07603; positive rows=72/72; positive mean domain-splits=6/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=5/6; mean descriptor Jaccard=0.49263
hypotheses.next_action: Run one focused rescue on immune/source_disjoint with larger null budget and stability-regularized feature selection to push descriptor Jaccard toward >=0.6.

hypotheses.name: Local linearity phase-boundary manifold screen
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth screen across immune/lung/external_lung, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {0,3,7,11}; computed local reconstruction-error and depth-wise ID-jump phase-boundary descriptors, blended with H70 baseline, and tested layer-order permutation, descriptor shuffle, and label permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.01676; positive rows=20/24; positive mean domain-splits=6/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this exact phase-boundary utility form; only reopen as a diagnostic feature inside a stronger positive backbone.

hypotheses.name: Perturbation topology-stability blend
hypotheses.method: Seed42 breadth screen across immune/lung/external_lung, source/target-disjoint splits, and layers {7,11}; measured H70 score stability under kNN-scale and metric-jitter perturbations, added stability descriptors to baseline, and tested feature/profile shuffles plus label permutation nulls.
hypotheses.result_value: mean=+0.00449; positive rows=7/12; positive mean domain-splits=4/6; positive mean null-gap domain-splits=0/6
hypotheses.next_action: Retire this stability-as-additive-score formulation; if revisited, treat stability as an error-analysis stratifier rather than direct utility feature.
